acknowledge_warnings: I have reviewed the {count} warning(s) and submit anyway.
admin_hint: Manage accounts. Administrators cannot see other users' travel data.
advances_hint: Amounts already paid by the employer; they are offset in the claim.
allocated_to_other: allocated to another trip on the same day
awaiting_payment_text: Total of submitted claims awaiting payment
claims_subtitle: Combine trips, outlays and advances into one claim.
confirm_delete_claim: Delete this draft? Its items become available again.
confirm_delete_trip: Delete the trip and all its expenses?
confirm_receipt_text: Is the receipt complete and legible? Confirming assigns a permanent receipt number and archives it unchanged.
drop_hint: Drop files here to upload them (JPEG, PNG, PDF).
employer_hint: Appears on every claim. Submitted claims keep the details they had.
err_advance_after_period: The advance is dated after the claim period.
err_advance_amount_invalid: The amount must be greater than zero.
err_advance_in_claim: Remove the advance from its claim first.
err_claim_employer_mismatch: The item belongs to another employer.
err_claim_item_taken: The item already belongs to another claim.
err_claim_not_paid: The claim is not marked as paid.
err_claim_period_invalid: The end is before the start.
err_claim_revision_changed: The claim changed since the preview. Please review it again.
err_claim_submitted_once: A claim that was submitted cannot be deleted.
err_conflict: The record changed in the meantime. Please reload.
err_employer_missing: Set up your employer in settings first.
err_expense_amount_invalid: The amount must be greater than zero.
err_expense_in_claim: Remove the outlay from its claim first.
err_expense_outlay_category: Outlays without a trip are tools, software or other.
err_expense_outlay_payer: Outlays without a trip are paid personally.
err_expense_travel_category: Trip expenses need a travel cost type.
err_export_failed: The PDF could not be generated. The claim stays a draft.
err_internal: Internal error. Please try again later.
err_locked: Belongs to a submitted claim and is locked.
err_login_rate_limited: Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
err_mileage_distance_invalid: The distance must be greater than zero.
err_oidc_already_linked: This sign-in is already linked to another account.
err_oidc_not_provisioned: This sign-in is not linked to an account. Log in with your password and link it in settings.
err_password_too_short: The password needs at least 10 characters.
err_receipt_confirmed_immutable: Confirmed receipts can only be voided.
err_receipt_linked: The receipt is still linked to an expense.
err_receipt_not_in_inbox: Only inbox receipts can be confirmed.
err_trip_day_outside: A day lies outside the trip.
err_trip_end_before_start: The return must be after the departure.
err_trip_exclude_reason: An excluded day needs a reason.
err_trip_in_claim: Remove the trip from its claim first.
err_trip_night_outside: A night lies outside the trip.
err_trip_override_reason: A location override needs a reason.
err_trip_stop_outside: A stop lies outside the trip time.
err_upload_pdf_encrypted: Encrypted PDFs are not supported. Please upload an unprotected copy.
err_upload_too_large: The file is too large (max {limitMb} MB).
err_upload_too_many_pages: The PDF has too many pages (max {limit}).
err_upload_too_many_pixels: The image resolution is too high.
err_upload_unreadable: The file cannot be read. Please upload a valid JPEG, PNG or PDF.
err_upload_unsupported: Only JPEG, PNG and PDF are supported.
err_user_last_admin: The last active administrator cannot be deactivated.
exclude_days_hint: After three months of work at the same place the meal allowance ends. Excluded days receive €0.
fuel_receipt: Fuel receipt (flagged when combined with mileage)
fx_debit_hint: As shown on the bank or card statement.
fx_rate_hint: e.g. ECB reference rate on the receipt date.
hosp_participants_hint: One name per line, including yourself.
inbox_empty_text: New receipts arrive here until you have checked them.
inbox_text: Receipts waiting to be checked or assigned
includes_breakfast_hint: Breakfast on the next day is suggested as provided and reduces the allowance – the invoice is not reduced.
issue_claim_empty: The claim contains no trips or outlays.
issue_expense_invalid_travel_category: Invalid cost type for a trip.
issue_expense_outside_trip: Expense is outside the trip period.
issue_fx_missing: Exchange rate or debit amount missing.
issue_hospitality_incomplete: Hospitality details incomplete (occasion, place, participants incl. external, confirmation).
issue_lodging_actual_without_expense: Actual-cost night without a hotel invoice.
issue_lodging_employer_paid_private_meth: A night paid by the employer cannot be reimbursed privately.
issue_lodging_expense_without_nights: The hotel invoice is not assigned to a night.
issue_lodging_mixed_methods: The invoice covers nights with different methods – please split it.
issue_lodging_unset: No lodging arrangement for this night.
issue_lodging_user_paid_employer_night: Personally paid invoice for a night marked as employer-paid.
issue_meal_overallocated: More allowance was claimed for this day in {claim} than is due – correct it there.
issue_meal_provided_without_allowance: Provided meal on a day without allowance (payroll review by employer).
issue_mileage_fuel_and_mileage: Fuel receipt and mileage on the same trip – possible double reimbursement.
issue_rate_mileage_missing: No mileage rate for the vehicle.
issue_receipt_duplicate: The same receipt was uploaded more than once.
issue_receipt_missing: No receipt linked (consider a self-issued receipt).
issue_receipt_unconfirmed: Linked receipt is not confirmed yet.
issue_vat_portion_inconsistent: Net + VAT does not equal the gross part.
issue_vat_portions_sum: The VAT parts do not add up to the total.
issue_vat_stated_deviates: Stated VAT deviates by more than one cent.
lodging_hint: How did you stay each night? This decides whether the hotel invoice or an allowance is reimbursed.
login_subtitle: Log in to manage your expense claims.
mark_paid_hint: Records the employer's transfer; the PDF stays unchanged.
meals_allowance_hint: Calculated per calendar day – at most one allowance per day.
meals_hint: Tick meals provided by or paid for by the employer (e.g. hotel breakfast). They reduce the meal allowance.
mileage_hint: Mileage allowance: total distance × vehicle rate.
new_claim_hint: Trips are suggested by return date, outlays by expense date.
night_employer_hint: No payout; the invoice is informational.
night_none_hint: The trip then counts as one-day travel.
night_private_allowance_hint: Allowance instead of invoice; an invoice is kept as evidence only.
no_claims_text: Create a claim for a month or a quarter.
no_outlays_text: Record e.g. a software subscription or tool you paid for yourself.
no_trips_text: Record your first business trip – allowances are calculated automatically.
open_amount_text: {trips} trips and {outlays} outlays not in a claim
outlay_dialog_hint: Reimbursed through the claim covering its date.
outlays_subtitle: Personally paid expenses without a trip – e.g. tools or software.
receipt_assign_hint: Assign the receipt when recording an expense.
receipt_confirm_later: Unconfirmed receipts must be confirmed in the inbox before submitting.
receipts_subtitle: Photograph or upload receipts, check them and assign them to expenses.
self_issued_hint: Substitute when no original exists. Carries no deductible VAT.
setup_employer_text: Set up your employer first. It appears on every claim.
setup_token_hint: From SPESEN_SETUP_TOKEN or the setup-token file in the data directory.
submit_hint: Submitting locks all data and creates the PDF and ZIP. Changes then require unlocking.
time_zone_hint: IANA time zone of departure and return, e.g. Europe/Berlin.
trip_itinerary_hint: Record each arrival in another country or a city with its own rate. The place last reached before midnight applies.
trip_locked_text: Unlock the claim with a reason to make changes.
trip_times_hint: Times of absence from home or the first place of work – not working hours.
trips_subtitle: Business trips with meal allowances, lodging and travel costs.
unlock_hint: The current version is kept unchanged. After correcting you submit a new version.
vat_hint: Optional. Gross parts per rate; together they must equal the total.
vat_sum_mismatch: The VAT parts do not add up to the total.
versions_hint: Every submitted version is kept with its files.
welcome_text: First set up your employer and your claim details.
